60:1: O you who believe, do not take My enemy and your enemy as friends. You approach them with love, whereas they have disbelieved in the truth that has come to you. They expel the Messenger and you because you believe in Allah, your Rabb. If you have striven in My way and gone out to seek My pleasure, do not secretly harbor love for them. I know what you conceal and what you disclose. Whoever of you does this has indeed strayed from the right way.
60:2: If they overcome you, they become enemies to you, they stretch out their hands and their tongues against you with evil, and they desire that you disbelieve.
60:3: On the Day of Resurrection, neither your relatives nor your children will benefit you. Allah separates between you. Allah is the Seer of what you do.
60:4: There was indeed a good example for you in Abraham and those with him. When they said to their people: 'We are free from you and from what you worship besides Allah; we have rejected you; eternal enmity and hatred have arisen between us and you until you believe in Allah as One.' Except for the word of Abraham to his father: 'I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have no power for you against anything from Allah.' 'Our Rabb, in You we have trusted, to You we have turned, and to You is the destination.'
60:5: Our Rabb! Do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve. Our Rabb! Forgive us. Indeed, You are the Mighty, the Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
60:6: Indeed, in them there is a good example for you, for those who hope for Allah and the Last Day; and whoever turns away, then indeed Allah, He is al-Ghani, al-Hamid.
60:7: It may be that Allah will establish love between you and those of them with whom you had enmity. Allah is capable of all things.
60:8: Allah does not forbid you from doing good to those who do not fight you regarding religion and do not expel you from your homes, and from acting justly toward them.
60:9: Allah only forbids you from taking as friends those who fight you regarding religion, expel you from your homes, and assist in your expulsion. Whoever takes them as friends, it is they who are the wrongdoers.
60:10: O you who believe! When believing women come to you having migrated, test them. Allah is best aware of their faith. If you know them to be believing women, do not return them to the disbelievers. Those women are not lawful for them, nor are they lawful for those women. Give the disbelievers what they have spent (their mahr). There is no sin upon you to marry them when you give them their mahr. Do not hold on to the marital ties of disbelieving women. Ask for what you have spent, and let them ask for what they have spent. This is Allah's judgment; He judges between you. Allah is Knower, Possessor of judgment.
60:11: And if anything of your wives escapes to the disbelievers and you retaliate, give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they spent, and fear Allah in whom you are believers.
60:12: O Prophet! When believing women come to you to pledge allegiance to you, on the condition that they will not associate anything with Allah, will not steal, will not commit adultery, will not kill their children, will not bring a slander they have fabricated between their hands and feet, and will not disobey you in a good deed, then accept their pledge of allegiance. Ask forgiveness for them from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
60:13: O you who believe! Do not take as friends a people with whom Allah is angry. They have despaired of the Hereafter, just as the disbelievers have despaired regarding the inhabitants of the graves.
